title: ポップ・メニュー・ポスターの飾り
subject_en: Showa-era retro shop decorations, each ONE separate piece centred in its cell: bold price-tag shapes, starburst badges, ribbon banners and menu board frames with an EMPTY centre of plain white so it becomes transparent. Limited vintage palette of red, mustard yellow, teal and cream. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 店舗のポップ・メニュー枠・ポスター枠・値札などを昭和レトロなタッチで描いた飾り素材です。文字や写真を載せる枠として使えます。
